🇲🇽🌎 <u>Sheinbaum: In the US Midterms, the People's Will Won</u>

President Sheinbaum hailed the wins of Xavier Becerra in California and Gina Hinojosa in Texas, both with at least one parent born in Mexico. The result "reflects the sentiment of the American people," she said. "They have a bond with their state, but also a bond with Mexicans." Becerra is the first Latino elected governor of California; the only one before him, Romualdo Pacheco, took office unelected in 1875. Hinojosa beat Greg Abbott, who was going for a fourth term, and becomes Texas's first Latina governor.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Mexico: Biggest Buyer of US Gas</u>

Mexico imported a record 7.71 billion cubic feet of US natural gas per day in August, up 4.3% from a year earlier, per EIA data reported by El Financiero. That makes Mexico the top customer for US gas worldwide, taking 28.4% of all US exports, almost three times Canada's 10.4%. It's the fourth month in a row above 7 bcf/d.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>Sheinbaum Gives a Liter of Gas for Cuba</u>

President Sheinbaum joined the Liga Cultural Antifascista's "One liter of gasoline for Cuba" drive. She bought the 25-peso stamp that pays for one liter and posed with Paco Ignacio Taibo II and the red jerrycan. The goal is 40,000 liters for the island. With Pemex shipments to Cuba suspended under US pressure, ordinary Mexicans are filling the tank one liter at a time.
banner: 1 LITER FOR CUBA: SHEINBAUM CHIPS IN

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Morena to Honor Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas</u>

Morena will hold a posthumous tribute to Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas, who died on October 28, pending his family's approval. Ariadna Montiel: "Many of us were born in the Frente Democrático Nacional… his greatest virtue was breaking with the regime at a time when that was impossible and unthinkable. For us, Cárdenas represents the beginnings of the Fourth Transformation." In 1988 the PRI regime "fixed" the count with a system crash.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Morena: The INE Rot Predates Taddei</u>

Morena leader Ariadna Montiel wants the Federal Audit Office (ASF) to go past Guadalupe Taddei and audit the INE under Córdova and Ugalde too, including officials, ex-officials and the private contractors. "It's a corruption network that was woven over several periods… it took root after the Pacto por México, which is when they decided to nationalize the INE." The same circle of suppliers held the electoral-materials contracts for two decades.
banner: MORENA: AUDIT INE BEFORE TADDEI TOO

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Xcaret Drops Its Fight Over Maya Symbols</u>

Grupo Xcaret has dropped its amparo against Maya communities, just before Mexico's Supreme Court moved to take the case. Communities in southern Quintana Roo filed the complaint with Indautor in 2022 over the commercial use of their cultural heritage. Xcaret's defense was that it had paid the "Gran Consejo Maya" 15 million pesos for permission. The underlying case is still in the courts, and Xcaret now says it will comply with whatever the judges rule.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Vaquita: Mexico Reports to CITES</u>

Mexico took its vaquita record to CITES in Geneva: more than 10,000 meters of banned gillnets pulled from the Upper Gulf of California in 2026, 800+ vessel verifications by the Navy, Profepa and Conapesca, and 400+ anti-net blocks sunk in the zero-tolerance zone. Satellite trackers are now on every small boat in San Felipe and Golfo de Santa Clara. Semarnat's Marina Robles told the meeting the point is that illegal fishing finally carries "legal and economic consequences."

🇲🇽🇨🇦 <u>Mexico–Canada Trade Up 16.7% While Washington Threatens</u>

Trade between Mexico and Canada reached $26.2 billion from January to August 2026, up 16.7% year on year, according to Statistics Canada data reported by El Economista. Mexican exports to Canada rose 15.7% to $16.48 billion, and Canadian exports to Mexico rose 18.4% to $9.73 billion. The jump follows the 2025–2028 Action Plan that Sheinbaum and Mark Carney signed in Mexico City in September 2025.

🇲🇽🏗️ <u>Baja California: 61 Billion Pesos in Public Works, Half for Water</u>

In her fifth report, Governor Marina del Pilar said Baja California invested more than 61 billion pesos in public works between 2022 and 2026, covering roads, hospitals, aqueducts and schools in all seven municipalities. Water got 30.44 billion pesos. She credited the room to spend to cutting operating costs and paying off historic liabilities.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>Mexico on the US Midterms: "We Will Respect Whatever the Result"</u>

On election day in the United States, President Sheinbaum refused to take sides: "We are going to wait for the result and we are going to respect whatever the result of the election is." She did point to the roughly 40 million people of Mexican origin living in the US, and she called the anti-Latino rhetoric of the American far right what it is: classism and racism.
banner: US MIDTERMS: MEXICO WILL RESPECT RESULT
